SELECT
          COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING_ASSIGNMENT','UNDER_REVIEW','CHANGES_REQUESTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
            AS open_count,
          COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING_ASSIGNMENT','UNDER_REVIEW','CHANGES_REQUESTED')
            AND REPLACE(REPLACE(sla_breach_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '') <= '2026-09-26T06:37:49.329592' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
            AS sla_breached_count,
          COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING_ASSIGNMENT','UNDER_REVIEW','CHANGES_REQUESTED')
            AND assigned_reviewer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
            AS unassigned_count,
          COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED')
            AND decided_at IS NOT NULL
            AND REPLACE(REPLACE(decided_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '') >= '2026-09-19T06:37:49.329592'
            AND REPLACE(REPLACE(decided_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '') <= '2026-09-26T06:37:49.329592'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
            AS completed_last_7_days,
          AVG(CASE WHEN status IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED')
            AND decided_at IS NOT NULL
            AND REPLACE(REPLACE(decided_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '') >= '2026-08-27T06:37:49.329592'
            AND REPLACE(REPLACE(decided_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '') <= '2026-09-26T06:37:49.329592'
            AND REPLACE(REPLACE(decided_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '') >= REPLACE(REPLACE(submitted_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '')
            THEN (julianday(REPLACE(REPLACE(decided_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '')) - julianday(REPLACE(REPLACE(submitted_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '')))
            ELSE NULL END)
            AS avg_turnaround_days,
          COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED')
            AND decided_at IS NOT NULL
            AND REPLACE(REPLACE(decided_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '') >= '2026-08-27T06:37:49.329592'
            AND REPLACE(REPLACE(decided_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '') <= '2026-09-26T06:37:49.329592'
            AND REPLACE(REPLACE(decided_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '') >= REPLACE(REPLACE(submitted_at, 'Z', ''), '+00:00', '')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
            AS turnaround_sample_size
        FROM submissions
